title: User Experience
subtitle: Native Android Responsiveness
details: Engineered from scratch to offer an intuitive typing interface, seamless spacebar cursor trackpad gestures, and smooth keypress feedback.
evidence: Official Play Store description confirms native Android UI design with zero-friction key input and instant touch response.

title: Performance
subtitle: Built with Kotlin
details: Written in native Kotlin to deliver minimal keystroke delay, optimal memory utilization, and zero background battery drain.
evidence: Developed using Kotlin and optimized specifically for maximum efficiency on modern Android devices.

title: Design
subtitle: Glassmorphism & Personalized Aesthetics
details: Offers full color customization for keys and text, custom background image integration with opacity controls, and custom TTF/OTF font loading.
evidence: Play Store features list complete color control, custom gallery background support, and TTF/OTF font file loading.

title: Ease of Use
subtitle: Intelligent Utilities At Your Fingertips
details: Includes context-aware predictions, instant spell checking, and an embedded math solver that calculates math equations like '=4*25' on the fly.
evidence: Calculates math equations starting with '=' directly in the suggestion bar and auto-corrects typos effortlessly.

title: Speed
subtitle: Multi-Touch & Fast Input Pipeline
details: Designed to handle rapid consecutive typing with multi-touch key logging and ultra-low input latency for fast typists.
evidence: Official store specifications list multi-touch logging support and low latency typing response.

title: Privacy
subtitle: 100% On-Device Local Processing
details: Keeps all text predictions, corrections, and personal dictionaries locally in a secure SQLite database. Auto-disables learning on sensitive fields (passwords, payment details).
evidence: Play Store privacy specification states all data processing occurs locally on-device without sending typing data to external servers.

title: Compatibility
subtitle: Offline Functionality & Global Devices
details: Functions completely offline without requiring continuous internet connectivity. Uses network access solely when activating external services like live translation.
evidence: Store metadata confirms no constant internet is required; network permissions are limited to optional cloud translation features.

title: Customization
subtitle: Height, Layouts & Multilingual Fonts
details: Allows users to adjust keyboard height, modify layout dimensions, import custom TTF/OTF fonts, and seamlessly switch between 8 supported languages.
evidence: Play Store listing explicitly details keyboard height adjustment, width controls, font loading, and multi-language support.
